column4: Referenced types Piece, Position, and PlayerScore are not defined, leaving the domain model incomplete.
Multiplicities are entirely missing; relationship types do not distinguish between composition and dependency.
Valid Mermaid syntax, though nested generics in Map~int_List~Piece~~ can be fragile in some renderers.
Excellent layout direction and clear labeling of association arrows.
Perfectly aligns with ADR terminology (ConfigVO, RuleSet, PieceCatalog).
